panels.title: Service overview · live health, not benchmark accuracy
Model endpoint probe
panels.description: Endpoint reachability only. Does not prove model generation or parsing works.

panels.title: HTTP availability
panels.description: POST redaction: 2xx / (2xx + 5xx). Excludes 4xx. Degraded 200 is available. No traffic is undefined. Color bands are provisional operational targets, not paging alerts.

panels.title: Degraded share of successful redactions
panels.description: Successful degraded / all successful redactions. Includes the selected-range trend; final failures after fallback count as errors instead. Color bands are provisional operational targets, not paging alerts.

panels.title: Session capacity used
panels.description: Color bands are provisional operational targets, not paging alerts.

panels.title: HTTP end-to-end latency · successful redactions
panels.description: Server entry through final ASGI body send: validation, sessions, pipeline and serialization. Excludes client network time.

panels.title: Pipeline latency · normal / degraded / error
panels.description: Orchestrator only. Independent of HTTP latency; percentile differences are not overhead measurements.

panels.title: Stage latency trend · p95
panels.description: Detection stages run concurrently; do not sum their percentiles. The smallest histogram bucket is 5ms: fast stub stages can share interpolated p95 values of 4.75ms.

panels.title: Degraded responses by cause and stage
Model outcomes and parsed success · selected range
panels.description: One final outcome per invocation. Counts and parsed success ratio use the same selected time range, including queue timeouts, cancellation and internal errors. No calls gives an undefined ratio. Parsed success is not privacy accuracy.

targets.expr: (sum by (prompt,outcome) (increase(vg_model_calls_total{job="vg-redactor",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))) or label_replace((sum by (prompt) (increase(vg_model_calls_total{job="vg-redactor",instance=~"$instance",outcome="ok"}[$__range])) / sum by (prompt) (increase(vg_model_calls_total{job="vg-redactor",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))), "outcome", "parsed_success", "prompt", ".*")

panels.title: Session lifecycle · selected range
panels.description: Estimated counts for expiry, active deletion and explicit capacity rejection. Other HTTP 503s are excluded; only rejection counts receive health colors.

targets.expr: label_replace(((sum by (event) (label_replace(increase(vg_records_removed_total{job="vg-redactor",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]), "event", "$1", "reason", "(.*)"))) or (label_replace(sum(increase(vg_capacity_rejected_total{job="vg-redactor",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])), "event", "capacity_rejected", "__name__", ".*")) or label_replace(0 * sum(vg_records_capacity{job="vg-redactor",instance=~"$instance"}), "event", "deleted", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(0 * sum(vg_records_capacity{job="vg-redactor",instance=~"$instance"}), "event", "expired", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(0 * sum(vg_records_capacity{job="vg-redactor",instance=~"$instance"}), "event", "capacity_rejected", "__name__", ".*")), "scope", "Selected range", "event", ".*")

panels.title: Components · last observed result
panels.description: Rules and Presidio report last actual execution, not continuous probes. Model endpoint reports reachability only.

panels.title: Versions and runtime backends
panels.description: Version and backend values, one setting per row. Mixed components include stub prompts/parsers. Version metadata is not benchmark accuracy.

panels.title: Diagnostics · model queues, session trends and API lifecycle
Model slot queue wait · p50/p95/p99
panels.description: Includes successful and timed-out queue waits. Separate from execution latency. The smallest histogram bucket is 5ms.

panels.title: Model execution and parsing · p50/p95/p99
panels.description: After acquiring the slot through generation and parsing. Queue-only timeouts have no execution sample. The smallest histogram bucket is 5ms.

panels.title: In-flight redaction requests
panels.description: Requests admitted to pipeline processing; excludes rejected validation and capacity requests.

panels.title: API lifecycle · selected route and method
panels.description: Use diagnostic filters to inspect redaction, restore and delete independently. Overview metrics remain POST redaction only.

panels.title: HTTP latency · selected operation and status
panels.description: Includes errors and restore/delete; separated by status so fast rejects do not hide slow successful operations.

panels.title: Rendered span decisions · selected range
panels.description: Rendered decisions, including attempts that later fail audit/serialization. Missed entities are absent; this cannot measure leak rate or accuracy.
